comment: polyself.c polyself(): a debug-mode Wizard puts on a wished ring of polymorph control, uses #polyself to become a vampire, then #polyself again and names a vampire bat. The vampire arm's y_n("Become a vampire bat?") is answered 'y' and polymon() runs. Before yes/no answers were characters, the port compared that answer with 'y' and always returned unchanged.
